run_doctest_shared_ptr: run the doctest suite that tests Boost.Python shared_ptr conversion and deleter introspection
test_shared_ptr_store: test storing a shared_ptr instance and verifying its reference count with count and look_store
test_shared_ptr_modify: test modifying a shared_ptr value and verify TypeError is raised for read-only types
test_shared_ptr_null: test nullifying a shared_ptr and verify identity returns None for null pointers
test_shared_ptr_factory: test the factory function that returns polymorphic shared_ptr types based on input value
